tool.name: FXVM
tool.description: FXVM provides Windows VPS hosting for MetaTrader and other trading terminals. Plans differ by memory, storage and how many terminals they suggest, and by which cities are available.
features: Windows Server VPS for trading terminals
Locations that include London, New York, Chicago, Amsterdam, Singapore, Tokyo and Dubai, depending on the plan
The Virtual Desktop plan is limited to one trading platform

plans.name: Virtual Desktop
plans.detail: Or $12.75/mo at the 15 percent discount shown. 1 terminal, 2 cores, 3 GB RAM, 10 GB.

plans.name: Lite
plans.detail: Or $21.25/mo at the discount shown. 1 to 2 terminals, 2 cores, 1.5 GB RAM, 60 GB.

plans.name: Basic
plans.detail: Or $29.75/mo at the discount shown. 3 to 4 terminals, 2 cores, 2.5 GB RAM, 80 GB.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.detail: Or $42.50/mo at the discount shown. 4 to 6 terminals, 2 cores, 4 GB RAM, 90 GB.
